context.purpose: Plot named numeric CSV series with units, explicit ranges and optional symmetric y uncertainty.
context.assumptions: Finite increasing x data, matching units, bounded local CSV; fixed margins and typography.
context.constraints: 2–2048 rows, 2–12 columns, 1–4 series; linear/log10, no missing data or clipping, ASCII labels.
context.inspection: Inspect raw native plot.svg/plot.png, captured.csv and trusted plot.gp. plot-summary.json records independent host inspection and is not native readback.
context.recovery: INVALID_PLOT_RANGE: increasing separated positive log ranges. INVALID_LOG_DATA: positive values and uncertainty endpoints. PLOT_UNIT_MISMATCH: declare matching column/axis units. INVALID_PLOT_DATA: rectangular numeric cells/header. INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND: configure Gnuplot.

workflow.scope: Run plotting jobs as isolated common workflow operations with independently verified outputs.

composition.scope: Shared document references, pure expressions and finite studies resolve before native plotting.

lifecycle.timeout: One total deadline covers native version/render and final verification; native CPU 60s, address space 512MiB, file 16MiB.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared process-group cancellation terminates the owned native process; check cancellation before publication.
lifecycle.logs: Authored/effective plans, source capture/digest, trusted script, stage input hashes, launcher, command submissions/stdout/stderr, raw SVG/PNG and host inspection summary are retained.
lifecycle.verification: Independent standard-library SVG geometry/labels and decoded PNG dimensions/series pixels use the captured CSV and declared axis transforms. Exact native/evidence/publication membership and trusted script/input bindings are checked.

losses: ASCII numeric cells only, no missing values/dates or automatic unit conversion.
data.scope: At most 1MiB, 2048 data rows, 12 named columns captured before execution.

traits.geometry: connected samples and optional symmetric y uncertainty

losses: Fixed plot design; no exact font/accessibility/raster equivalence claim.
